title: 美国燃油价格或上行，供应瓶颈成焦点
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Francisco Blanche, a bank of America writing. We do not think the world has a crude oil problem right now, but are very worried about fuel availability.
segments.zh: 美银的弗朗西斯科·布兰奇写道，我们认为目前世界不存在原油问题，但非常担心燃料供应。

segments.en: Francisco joins us now for more. Francisco, wonderful to see you. Great to see you.
segments.zh: 弗朗西斯科现在加入我们，很高兴见到你。

segments.en: What's going on? Why are oil prices declining today? Well, I mean, the market is incredibly volatile.
segments.zh: 发生了什么？为什么今天油价下跌？市场波动性极大。

segments.en: We have this news that maybe there is more crude oil coming through the street, but we still have three of the world's four main refining centers.
segments.zh: 有消息称可能有更多原油进入市场，但全球四大炼油中心中仍有三个面临问题。

segments.en: Basically, they're tailed for one reason or another, whether it is Russia's ban on petroleum fuel exports, gasoline and diesel, or whether it is the straight,
segments.zh: 基本上，它们都因某种原因受限，无论是俄罗斯禁止石油燃料出口，还是其他原因。

segments.en: not getting the products through, or China, which is still holding back fuel exports
segments.zh: 或者产品无法通过，或者中国仍限制燃料出口以保护国内市场。

segments.en: to protect the domestic markets. So there is bottlenecks everywhere.
Usually, we do have a fuel problem, refined products problem, which is something that we are seeing and pricing.
segments.zh: 通常，我们确实面临燃料问题，即成品油问题，这是我们正在看到并定价的。

segments.en: And in Europe right now, we're seeing natural gas prices up some more than 9% so far on this on the week.
segments.zh: 目前在欧洲，天然气价格本周迄今上涨超过9%。

segments.en: Is this a European problem, or is this a global problem? This is a global gas problem.
segments.zh: 这是欧洲的问题还是全球的问题？这是全球天然气问题。

segments.en: Listen, and the issue is, of course, that right now, in the fifth heat wave in Europe, nuclear power is running low.
segments.zh: 听着，问题在于，目前欧洲正经历第五波热浪，核电出力不足。

segments.en: There is no water in the European rivers.
Still there are clips. So there are clips on top of that.
You know, plus the water levels are warming up. So it's all coming together.
segments.zh: 再加上水温升高，各种因素叠加。
